# 毛孩子

> 毛孩子是已在 Apple App Store 上架的 iPhone 宠物照顾应用。它给猫狗主人在本机记录今日待办、健康情况和就诊摘要。英文商店名是 Pet Care Notes。没有账号、云同步、广告或分析 SDK。

## Official names

- Chinese home-screen name: 毛孩子
- Chinese App Store name: 毛孩子宠物健康记录
- English App Store name: Pet Care Notes
- English home-screen name: Care Notes
- Former name, no longer used in the store: 毛迹
- Xcode module name (not a public product name): PetCare
- Bundle ID: com.codex.maoke
- Version: 1.1
- Price: free
- Category: Lifestyle (secondary: Utilities)
- Platform: iPhone / iOS 17.0 or later. Not an Android or web app.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6788202619
- Apple ID: 6788202619

## What it does

- Pet profiles for cats and dogs (allergies, conditions, usual meds, care notes, vaccines, deworming, exams)
- Today desk: tasks, daily check-in (appetite, water, stool, mood), local reminders
- Health records and a timeline, including weight trend
- 7 / 14 / 30 day visit summaries, export as PDF or image
- Temporary-care list for someone else looking after one pet
- On-device care helper that only sorts keywords the user typed; it does not diagnose
- Zip backup with photos; user exports and imports it. No iCloud or CloudKit sync
- Interface in 13 languages; follow the system or lock one language under Me

## What it does not do

- No account, sign-in, or household sharing
- No iCloud / CloudKit / developer cloud sync
- No ads, analytics SDK, crash-reporting SDK, or tracking
- No Apple Health / HealthKit, no contacts, no continuous location
- No online diagnosis, prescription, or dose advice
- Not a medical device and not a replacement for a veterinarian

## Privacy

App Store privacy answers: Tracking = No, Data Not Collected.
Pet files, tasks, health notes, photos, and summaries stay on the iPhone by default.
Photos are copied into the app only after the user picks them with the system picker. The camera stays closed.
Notifications are local system alerts after the user allows them.
Content leaves the device only when the user exports, shares, or emails support.
